name: align-center
description: A centered square with separated horizontal and vertical axes.
useCase: Center an object on both axes.
misuse: Do not confuse this action with text alignment or a fixed grid position.

16.reason: The silhouette is independently placed around the artboard center with matched extents on its symmetry axes; compare at native size beside the foundation shapes. Text master: 1.5px construction. The complete silhouette is centered within the shared 12 × 12 drawing area.

24.reason: The silhouette is independently placed around the artboard center with matched extents on its symmetry axes; compare at native size beside the foundation shapes. Interface master: 1.75px construction. The complete silhouette is centered within the shared 18 × 18 drawing area.
